work.h2a: How a Meta account is built

steps.t: Build the account to match the client's goal.
steps.d: Campaigns and ad sets are set up inside the client's own ad account, named so your team can read them.

steps.t: Test creative in batches you can approve.
steps.d: Hooks, formats and offers go into a test plan first, so no ad runs that you have not seen.

steps.t: Build audiences from the client's own data.
steps.d: Custom and lookalike audiences come from first-party lists, with consent rules respected.

steps.t: Check tracking before you scale spend.
steps.d: Pixel and Conversions API events are tested, so the numbers in your report can be trusted.

steps.t: Send weekly notes you can read on the call.
steps.d: Each week's changes come with a short reason, and scaling follows the client's margin, not platform ROAS.
